name: Cocoa butter on stretch marks
what_people_do: Rub cocoa butter cream or butter into the belly, hips and breasts in pregnancy, and onto scars.
why_they_say_it_works: Said to keep skin supple and stop or fade stretch marks.

documented_by.source: Buchanan K, Fletcher H, Reid M 2010, Int J Gynaecol Obstet, PMID 19793585
documented_by.quote_or_summary: A trial was run in a clinic with mainly Afro-Caribbean women because cocoa butter is widely used; I did not open a survey of how many use it. UNVERIFIED as a documentation of the habit.

evidence.tested: Cocoa butter cream vs placebo to prevent stretch marks
evidence.finding: Stretch marks in 44% on cocoa butter vs 55% on placebo, not significant (P=0.09). Cocoa butter cream does not prevent striae gravidarum.

source.name: Buchanan K, Fletcher H, Reid M 2010, Int J Gynaecol Obstet, PMID 19793585

harm_note: No harm identified; wasted money more than harm.
gaps: Survey of use not found; scar evidence not searched.
